notes.subject: ⟨d nutenti⟩
notes.rationale: taɛbranit ur tesɛi ara taɣect deg umḍfir n tenfalit n tɣawsiwin, taqbaylit tesra-t

notes.subject: azallag
notes.rationale: גלגל: azallag neɣ lɣuba ara d-izzizwen s ruaḥ — yelti d azallag kan ayef tettwaf tlalit n wawal

notes.subject: ruaḥ
notes.rationale: רוח yettwaru s timesliyin-is: ruaḥ, maca mačči d 'aḍu' weḥd-s

notes.subject: Elohim-iw
notes.rationale: anuṣṣi n unammar ɣer Elohim s yisem-is

translation: Elohim-iw, err-itent ⟨d nutenti⟩ am uzallag, am teɣsit yuẓen qbel ruaḥ.
